title: No role file, skill or decision text tells a role it may run above its row; each role file states only its own model and effort
why: Prose that offers Opus by override confuses roles and prompts the owner.
source: Owner 14:09 CST Nov 13 via the retrospective: "this shd be true for the other roles markdowns too frankly".
note: Filed 14:10 CST Nov 13. Broadens ruling own-r3-reviewer-sonnet-high from the reviewer to every role. Done-check: a grep over agents/ and skills/ for override-to-Opus wording finds no role line; the guard refusal stays as the backstop. Fold with step model-layout-to-table (round-3 cleanup). Exceptions in agent-model-cap (Plan, designer, design reviewer, refuter, Audit: Explore) are rows of the table, not override wording; the lane keeps them as each role's own line.
